lastData.title: 토너 상세 이미지 디자인
lastData.textTail:
uently and more generously than people expect, so a generous 500ml size makes sense.

Required Korean text, exactly this meaning, large and clean:
Headline:
토너는 생각보다 빨리 줄어듭니다

Subheadline:
세안 후 첫 단계부터 화장솜, 스킨팩, 레이어링까지
매일 쓰는 토너라면 넉넉함이 먼저입니다

Four card labels:
세안 후 첫 단계
화장솜에도 넉넉하게
건조한 날 레이어링
스킨팩으로 집중 수분

Bottom transition copy:
그래서 이 토너는
500ml 대용량에 집중했습니다

Visual structure:
- Top headline over soft aqua water glow.
- Middle: 4 rounded cards/lifestyle vignettes showing realistic watery toner usage.
- Bottom: soft aqua transition band with the 500ml message and a moderate product bottle or cotton/water scene.

Visual content:
- Clear watery toner, cotton pads, clean after-wash skin, palms pressing toner, cotton/sheet pack mood.
- Toner must look transparent and watery, not white lotion or cream.

Hard constraints:
- Absolutely no visible version marker such as V1, V2, V3, V4, renewal, proof, candidate, cut, detail cut.
- No embedded cut numbers, no POINT, no STEP, no big numeric badges.
- No medical/therapeutic claims.
- Do NOT use: 피부 깊은 곳까지, 속부터 충전, 피부 장벽 강화, 진정 효과, 민감 피부도 안심, 안전한 성분만, 트러블 완화, 치료, 재생, 회복.
- Avoid tiny Korean paragraphs. Keep text large and clean.
- Korean text must be natural, correctly spelled, and not garbled.
- Do not write the product name incorrectly. If product name appears, it must be 히알루론산 토너 or HYALURONIC ACID TONER 500ml.
- No fake certificates, fake test documents, fake EWG logos.

Desired feeling:
Soft, helpful, premium, practical. Buyer reaction: “맞아, 토너는 많이 쓰니까 500ml가 좋겠다.”
